##

Welcome to the biRd blog!

The blog is named as a mix of two things I really like: birds and R! Here I publish texts related to science, ecology, ornithology, and also statistics in the R environment.

I created this blog as a way to share what I have learned and, at the same time, keep learning about the topics mentioned above.

My name is Ivana Cardoso, and I am a biologist and scientist. If you want to know more about me, you can find more information [here](about_author.qmd).

I hope the biRd blog is useful to you in some way.

Happy reading!
